queries_run: Motorola Solutions business model subscription platform shift 2026
Motorola Solutions channel partners distribution go-to-market change 2026

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 描述銷售模式：自家業務團隊聚焦最大客戶，其餘透過通路夥伴（獨立經銷商、分銷商、軟體商）；未見通路結構性改變的描述。
findings.excerpt: Our sales model includes both direct sales by our in-house sales force, which tends to focus on our largest accounts, and sales through our channel partner program. Our trained channel partners include independent dealers, distributors and software vendors around the world.

channel_business_model_shift.note: 搜尋未找到 2026 年新的 go-to-market／通路去中介化公告；Arrow EMEA 分銷協議與 PartnerEmpower 皆無法確認日期。訂閱化／雲端平台（Avigilon Alta）線索見 clues，僅聚合站／Memoori 摘要，未讀到原文。

clues.claim: Memoori 評估：Avigilon Alta 雲端影像＋門禁平台，影像營收 2025 年成長 10%、2026Q1 成長 16%，轉向軟體與經常性服務。
clues.source: Memoori, Motorola Solutions Video Surveillance Strategy: An Independent Assessment
